summary: Linkage Global Inc filed a Form 6-K announcing a Nasdaq ticker symbol change from LGCB to UZX effective May 18, 2026, following a token purchase transaction with UZX DAO Foundation consummated on April 8, 2026. The transaction involves integrating UZX DAO Foundation's AI technology and digital asset ecosystem into Linkage Global's cross-border e-commerce platform. No financial terms (stake size, price, premium) or board recommendation are disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate update on a symbol change, not a transformative M&A event. What to watch: further disclosures on the token purchase terms or business combination risks.
